units.source_text: "世界上所有的噩梦，历史上所有的噩梦都是这样产生的。

en.t: All the nightmares in the world, all the nightmares in history, are born in this way.

units.source_text: 但在光天化日之下，浑身是血的苦闷而死的人的影子，会给噩梦勾勒出清楚的轮廓，使噩梦完全物质化。

en.t: But in broad daylight, the shadow of a person who has died in agony, covered head to toe in blood, gives the nightmare a clear outline and makes it completely material.

units.source_text: 噩梦并不是我们的苦恼，只不过是他人的肉体的一种强烈的痛苦罢了。

en.t: A nightmare is not our own suffering; it is merely an intense pain in another person's body.

units.source_text: 然而，他人的痛苦，我们是感受不到的。

en.t: And yet we cannot feel the pain of others.
What kind of salvation is that!"
